'''Beidlo''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who worked as a bodyguard for [[Treytis Prash]]. He was killed by [[Celia Durasha]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Beidlo is a Tuckerization of [[Mike Beidler]], a ''Star Wars'' military tech advisor and continuity editor.
